item.title: Lian Zhen and Po Jun in the Career Palace: A Career That Dares to Break Patterns and Turning the Confining Star and Change Into Grounded Success

The risk is frequent change, stubbornness and heavy depletion, so the key is making change planned with a way back and cash flow and hearing opinions before deciding.
